name: Trade Transaction Identification 24
definition: Provides details on transaction and conducting counterparty.

TechnicalRecordIdentification.name: Technical Record Identification
TechnicalRecordIdentification.definition: Unique identifier of a record in a message used as part of error management and status advice message.

ActionType.name: Action Type
ActionType.definition: Indication of the action type of the transaction.

ReportingTimeStamp.name: Reporting Time Stamp
ReportingTimeStamp.definition: Indicates the date and time of the submission of the report to the trade repository.

DerivativeEventTimeStamp.name: Derivative Event Time Stamp
DerivativeEventTimeStamp.definition: Indicates the time stamp of a derivative event.

OtherCounterparty.name: Other Counterparty
OtherCounterparty.definition: Unique code identifying the entity with which the reporting counterparty concluded the transaction.

UniqueIdentifier.name: Unique Identifier
UniqueIdentifier.definition: Choice between a Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) or a proprietary identifier as agreed with the counterparty.

MasterAgreement.name: Master Agreement
MasterAgreement.definition: Details related to the master agreement.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
